dog.description_text:
💙 WATSON
🐶 1 year old | Shihpoo (Shih Tzu/Poodle Mix)
⚖️ 12 lbs. | Neutered
Looking for a little shadow who wants to be part of everything you do? Meet Watson! ❤️
Watson is a 12-pound bundle of love who is happiest when he's right where he thinks he belongs—with his people.
🐾 Does well with other dogs
🚪 Knows how to use a doggie door
❤️ Very loving and affectionate
🛏️ Sleeps through the night in the same room as his humans
👨‍👩‍👧 Loves being included in family life
dog.name: Watson
